settings.title: Settings
settings.high-contrast-hint: Uses WCAG AAA high-contrast colors and crisp borders across the app.
settings.dyslexia-friendly-hint: Uses readable sans-serif fonts, generous spacing, and left-aligned text.
settings.preview-sample: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. Adjust typography and contrast settings to make long reading sessions effortless.
settings.reduced-motion-hint: Minimizes transitions and animations across the interface.
settings.enhanced-focus-hint: Displays high-visibility focus rings when navigating by keyboard.
settings.screen-reader-announcements-hint: Announces page changes, book openings, and setting updates to assistive technology.
settings.keyboard-hints-hint: Enables Arrow keys for page turns and Ctrl+, to open Settings.
settings.tts-enabled-hint: Adds offline Read Aloud controls to the reader for listening to the current book.
settings.tts-rhvoice-path-placeholder: Auto-detected on PATH or browse to RHVoice-test
settings.tts-rhvoice-missing-body-windows: No additional software is needed on Windows — everything is included in the RHVoice voice installer (Microsoft SAPI 5). Download and install any voice from the link below, then click Re-check.
settings.tts-rhvoice-missing-body-other: RHVoice was not found on this device. Install RHVoice and a voice for your language from the official RHVoice page, or browse to an existing RHVoice-test executable, then click Re-check.
settings.tts-rhvoice-inline-alert-windows: No RHVoice voices are installed yet. Download and run a Windows SAPI 5 voice installer — no additional software is needed.
settings.tts-rhvoice-inline-alert-other: RHVoice was not found on this device. Install RHVoice and a voice pack, or browse to RHVoice-test.
settings.tts-cleanup-formatting-hint: Expands common abbreviations (e.g. Dr., Mr., etc.) and removes footnote numbers or stray symbols before speaking.
settings.tts-highlight-sentence-hint: Highlights the currently spoken sentence inside the book for visual tracking.
settings.tts-auto-page-turn-hint: Automatically turns to the next page and continues reading when the current page finishes.
settings.vtt-enabled-hint: Enables microphone voice commands in the reader and tag dictation in the organizer.
settings.vtt-unsupported: Voice recognition is not available in this runtime environment.
settings.config-description: All settings are saved automatically on every change to a plain, human-readable JSON file and loaded automatically on every boot.
settings.about-description: An offline, distraction-free desktop EPUB reader built for comfort, customization, and seamless reading. Featuring offline Text-to-Speech narration, dyslexia-friendly typography, customizable contrast themes, and intuitive shelf organization. Made with love for the accessibility of all.
settings.about-github-sub: Browse source code, report issues, and star the project
settings.about-kofi-sub: Buy a coffee to support continued development and accessibility work
settings.about-made-with-love: Made with love for the accessibility of all
